comment: Every game client this project can package, and the app identity each one ships under.
The CI matrix builds 'jm' and 'gaius' side by side.
Each payload gets its own bundle identifier, so the apps install alongside each
other and keep separate world storage instead of fighting over the same slot.

jm.label: 26.3-JM
jm.description: Eaglercraft 26.2 by o_xer with selected 26.3 features backported, by Joey-JM. Joins Eaglercraft wss:// servers.

eagler263.label: Eaglercraft 26.3
eagler263.description: Prebuilt single-file Eaglercraft 26.3 client published by DhyeyBG. The repository contains only the compiled index.html - there is no source to build from.
eagler263.multiplayer: Eaglercraft servers (wss:// via EaglerXServer proxies) - expected, not verified

gaius.label: Gaius 26.3
gaius.description: Official Minecraft 26.3 client bytecode compiled with TeaVM. Joins ordinary offline-mode Java servers through a RelayNode.
gaius.multiplayer: Ordinary Java servers (relay tunnel, offline-mode only). Cannot join Eaglercraft wss:// servers.

gaius-26.2.label: Gaius 26.2
gaius-26.2.multiplayer: Ordinary Java servers (relay tunnel, offline-mode only).

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Whatever the GAME_URL environment variable / repository variable points at. Use this for a self-hosted client.goldhq.net offline export.
